text.tspan: Multidimensional poverty is defined as being deprived in a range of health, education and living standards
indicators. The MPI is a measure that combines the prevalence and the intensity of multidimensional poverty on
a scale from 0 to 1. Higher values indicate higher poverty.
Data source: Alkire et al. (2025) - The Global Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) 2025
Note: Estimates based on the most recent household survey data (between 2013 and 2023). A separate dataset is produced to monitor trends
over time. Where data for 2013 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2014 and 2023 is shown instead.
